Description:
Peering from behind a towering tree, a whimsical creature captures your attention with its keen eyes. Its fluffy form, resembling a bipedal rabbit, fox, raccoon, or other enchanting woodland creature, emanates an aura of curiosity and grace.
Bertles possess a gentle and herbivorous nature, thriving on a vegetarian diet. While their love for greens is unmatched, it is their remarkable agility that truly sets them apart, as they excel in evading danger and traversing treacherous terrains with ease. This makes them excellent adventurers who leave thier homes in search of great wonders and stories to tell when they return!
Bertles are known for their tribal societies, where they forge strong bonds within their communities. Living harmoniously amidst lush woodlands and enchanting meadows, these tribes prioritize unity and cooperation. Standing at heights ranging from 1 meter to 2 meters, depending on the species, Bertles showcase an array of vibrant hair and eye colorations, adding to the diversity of their appearances. They, however, are not afraid to fight! They can't hunt for food, but some might have retractible claws or sharp fangs, making them great exceptional monster hunters!

Creation.Stat Restrictions: Your Dexterity must be at least 1.

Language: You speak Common and a number of chosen languages equal to your Intelligence or Presence (whichever is higher).
Other: Due to the variations in Bertle species, you can choose if you want your size to be Small or Medium.

Combat Extras: You can jump 3 meters without requiring a Check
~Skipper~.Effect:
Your starting Stats distribution is 0, 0, 0, 2 (instead of -1, 0, 1, 2).
You have +1 Movement Speed
You can jump 3 meters without requiring a Check (e.g. over enemies, gaps, etc).

Starting Abilities Description: Bertles have extra movement speed compared to other Races, and can naturally jump very high. That speed will be detrimental in combat!

~Tall Paws (or Hooves)~.Effect: You are immune to being Slowed.

~Carnivore~.Effect: Once inbetween Worthy Combats, you can eat a piece of meat to restore 1 Health.
~Carnivore~.Downside:
You can not eat grains and can only lightly eat vegetables.
Exclusive with Herbivore.
~Carnivore~.Notes: If you do, you take 1d4 Damage.

Extras: Half of your meals can consist of grass and leaves, but you can not eat meat.
~Herbivore~.Effect:
Gain +2 Max Health.
Half of your meals can consist of grass and leaves.
~Herbivore~.Downside:
You can not eat meat.
Exclusive with Carnivore.
~Herbivore~.Notes: If you do, you take 1d4 Damage.

Combat Extras: -50% Slash Damage taken from behind while unarmored.
~Thick Shell~.Effect: While unarmored, you take -50% Slash Damage when hit from behind instead of having +1 Movement Speed.

Combat Extras: When you gain Shielding, give it +1
~Horns~.Effect:
Whenever you gain Shielding, increase its value by 1.
You have +2 in Intimidation.
~Horns~.Downside: You can't wear helmets (hats might fit you, though).

~Feral Claws~.EffectGreen:
Critical Strike - if you rolled minimum, apply a Combo.
Critical Strike - if you rolled maximum, the target becomes Blinded.

~Sharpen With Magic~.Effect:
Permanently sharpen your claws with a ^magic weapon^ worth at least 25 XP.
Increase the Damage of Feral Claws by +1.
The magic weapon is then destroyed.

~Avian Wings~.Effect:
Quickly fly up to 3 meters (e.g. almost instantly).
Passively, you don't take Falling Damage.
~Avian Wings~.Upgrade: Your arms and hands become bird-like wings, but that makes it harder for you to hold and use weapons.

Combat Extras: -50% Smash Damage taken while below 50% Health
~Thick Fur~.Effect:
You take -50% Cold Damage.
You take -50% Smash Damage while below 50% Health

Combat Bonuses: You swim at your Movement Speed + 1 meter
~Fins~.Effect:
You have +2 Initiative.
You can swim at your normal Movement Speed + 1 meter.

Combat Extras: You can use Dexterity instead of Intelligence or Presence for weapons and Abilities
~Aerodynamic~.Effect: In Abilities or weapons that use Intelligence or Presence, you can use your Dexterity instead.
~Aerodynamic~.Notes: E.g. Chilling Shout becomes 12 + ^Dexterity^ instead of 12 + ^Presence^. Phase Orb becomes 2d6 + ^Dexterity + Dexterity^ instead of 2d6 + ^Intelligence + Presence^.

~All Eyes and Noses~.Effect: Whenever you fail a Presence Check, you can spend 2 Health to reroll it.
~All Eyes and Noses~.Notes: You always know if you failed a Presence Check.
